name: routerguard-frontend
description: RouterGuardian UI — a single self-contained HTML file. There is NO build step and no dependencies; React and Tailwind load from a CDN. The FastAPI backend serves this file at http://localhost:8000, which is the supported way to run it.

scripts.start:
node -e "console.log('
  There is no frontend server to run.

  The backend serves the UI. From the project root:

    docker compose up --build

  then open http://localhost:8000

  (Serving this folder on its own port also works, but the UI
   will call the API at http://localhost:8000 — the backend
   must be running either way.)
')"
